answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 69 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 9 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 69 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 660 bought sponsors, each risking real money. A quill of doubt is healthy, a sable of proof is required, and a comet of patience is the price of a clean panel.
